channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: Catherine O'Hara played drunk better than anyone
item.description: O'Hara observed people closely; she found the tics, the mannerisms, the specific beats of drunkenness and used them to open us up to her characters' frailty, their vulnerability, their humanity.

item.title: Feds arrest Don Lemon, Minnesota journalist and 2 others over church protest
item.description: Lemon was arrested by U.S. agents days after covering an anti-ICE protest at a St. Paul, Minn., church. U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi called the protest a "coordinated attack."

item.title: Catherine O'Hara, who starred in 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: O'Hara enjoyed a six-decade career in TV and films playing sometimes over-the-top, but endearing characters. "I loved playing cocky untalented people," she told Fresh Air in 1992.

item.title: Tim Walz says Trump administration wants to 'twist reality' in Minnesota
item.description: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz about the Trump administration's immigration crackdown in his state.

item.title: Judge rules Luigi Mangione should not face death penalty
item.description: A federal judge dropped two of the charges against Luigi Mangione — the man accused of fatally shooting UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson — making his case no longer eligible for the death penalty.

item.title: 'Melania' is Amazon's airbrushed and astronomically pricey portrait of the First Lady
item.description: Amazon paid $40 million to acquire the documentary, and is spending $35 million more to promote it.

item.title: Photos: Thousands once again protest ICE in Minneapolis and across the U.S.
item.description: Demonstrators in Minneapolis and other U.S. cities participated in protests as part of a "national shutdown" to end immigration enforcement operations.

item.title: What to know about the partial government shutdown
item.description: The Senate passed a measure to avert a shutdown on Friday. But with the House on recess, funding for broad stretches of the federal government has technically lapsed.

item.title: DHS keeps making false claims about people. It's part of a broader pattern
item.description: Trump administration officials have falsely linked Alex Pretti and Renee Macklin Good to domestic terrorism. It's part of a larger pattern by the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: FAQ: What is wind chill, and why is it dangerous?
item.description: Strong winds can make it feel a lot colder than the thermometer suggests. Protect yourself by covering exposed skin and sheltering inside.
